subject: ela
cluster: Research to build and present knowledge
intro: Eighth graders gather relevant information from multiple print and digital sources, use search terms effectively, assess the credibility and accuracy of each source, and quote or paraphrase the data and conclusions of others while avoiding plagiarism and following a standard citation format. Paraphrasing restates an idea in your own words; both quoting and paraphrasing require citation.

items.prompt: What is the difference between QUOTING and PARAPHRASING?

steps: Quoting uses the exact words in quotation marks; paraphrasing restates the idea in your own words.
So quoting is word-for-word; paraphrasing is in your own words.
solution.answer: Quoting uses exact words; paraphrasing restates the idea in your own words.

items.prompt: Do you cite a source when you PARAPHRASE it?

steps: So yes, you must cite it.
solution.answer: Yes, you must still cite it.

items.prompt: How do effective SEARCH TERMS help research?

steps: Specific keywords find more relevant, accurate results.
So good search terms locate reliable sources faster.
solution.answer: Specific keywords find more relevant, accurate sources.

items.prompt: Using exact words in quotation marks is ____.
Restating an idea in your own words is ____.
You must ____ a source even when paraphrasing.
